episodes.175794: A cold frontal passage produced gusty winds across portions of the Chesapeake Bay.
episodes.175795: A cold frontal passage produced gusty winds across portions of the James River.
episodes.175839: A cold front with a fine line of convection quickly moved through the state on the evening of November 30th.  The line was strongest across Southern New Hampshire where numerous trees and wires were blown down as the storms quickly moved from west to east.  Sporadic trees were also reported down across parts of the state but the damage was more concentrated across Hillsborough and Carrol Counties.
episodes.175840: A cold front with a fine line of convection quickly moved through the state on the evening of November 30th. The line was strongest across southwest Maine in Cumberland County where numerous trees and wires were blown down as the storms quickly moved from west to east. A few reports of trees down were also reported across parts of the state but the damage was more concentrated across Cumberland County.
episodes.175853: A cold upper-level trough moved east across Northwest California during early December. Some impacts due to small hail were observed along the coast, while locally heavy snow occurred across the interior mountains.
episodes.175988: Storm force west to northwest wind gusts were still occurring at Stannard Rock early morning on the 1st at the tail-end of a storm event.
